dct_title_s: Map of South Part of St. Louis County, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: Map of the southern portion of St. Louis County, featuring handwritten notations by Ray Segar in red ink and pencil regarding logging railroads and camps in the area. The handwritten notations include information on the following: Railroad line and logging camps noted with the letter "C."
dct_creator_sm: Prepared from official surveys by E. K. Coe C. E. and John Harrison draftsman
